title: Carriage Spent on Collections That Went Unused, Taken Off a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Exchange Difference
content:
The carriage the retailer spent on collections that went unused is then taken off. Where two or more prepaid labels or collection bookings stand on the return and the schedule charges the customer for a carrier collection, the schedule's carrier collection fee is taken off. Where exactly one prepaid label or collection booking stands on the return and the schedule charges the customer for a carrier collection, half that fee is taken off. In any other case nothing is taken off.

## The fee the deduction is measured by

Whether the Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule the line falls under charges the customer for a carrier collection, and at what figure, is read from the carrier collection fee published against it:

| Return schedule | Carrier collection fee | Does the schedule charge one? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 14.99 USD | yes |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0.00 USD | no |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 0.00 USD | no |

## The ladder

| Prepaid labels or collection bookings standing on the return | The schedule | Amount taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| two or more | charges the customer for a carrier collection | the schedule's carrier collection fee |
| exactly one | charges the customer for a carrier collection | half that fee, rounded to the cent |
| any number | charges nothing for a carrier collection | nothing |
| none | either way | nothing |

Both of the first two conditions are compound: the count of labels or bookings standing on the return and the schedule charging for a carrier collection are required together.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*Three collection bookings standing on a return under a schedule whose carrier collection fee is 14.99 USD.* Two or more stand on it, so 14.99 USD is taken off.

*One prepaid label standing on a return under that same schedule.* Exactly one stands on it, so half of 14.99 USD, which is 7.495 USD rounded to the cent, that is 7.50 USD, is taken off.

*Three collection bookings standing on a return under a schedule whose carrier collection fee is 0.00 USD.* That schedule charges nothing for a carrier collection, so nothing is taken off.

*No label and no collection booking standing on the return.* Nothing is taken off.
